title: MEMEVOBENCH: BENCHMARKING MEMORY MISEVOLUTION IN LLM AGENTS

bias_targets.methodology: Testing agents across diverse QA and workflow scenarios designed around 36 distinct failure modes inspired by cognitive bias research, measuring how flawed historical memories cause behavioral drift such as overgeneralization, anchoring, and historical label fixation.

Constructing memory pools where multiple simulated sources (e.g., forum posts, personal notes, knowledge snippets) consistently endorse the same flawed advice, evaluating if the agent mistakes consistency across sources for reliability.

Simulating asymmetric user feedback across multi-round interactions, where safe or conservative responses are penalized with negative reinforcement, while risky but immediate shortcuts receive positive reinforcement, to measure systematic drift toward unsafe patterns.
